Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Supply, Installation, Commissioning and War ranty of Low Magnetic field detector system without cryogenics as technical specification annexure attached. 2. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (a) The overall size of different modules (length, breadth, and height) as well as the weight should be clea rly indicated in the quotation. (b) Known low magnetic field acquisition should be demonstrated inside magnetic shielded environment at the purchaser’s site (c) Supplier should undertake to supply both operating instructions and service manual in the event of the order. (d) The supplier shall undertake to install and commission the system in the purchaser’s laboratory and de monstrate its satisfactory performance, including achieving an approximate sensitivity of the magnetic fiel d detector system as specified in the technical specifications. (e) All the hardware as well as the software should be guaranteed for trouble free operation at the purchas er’s site at least for a period of one year from the date of commissioning. 3. Bank Guarantee shall be from SBI or any nationalized bank except Gramin/Cooperative Bank. 4. Post supply inspection is not allowed. Any offer containing the conditions of post supply ins pection will be summarily rejected. 5. All the other terms & conditions as per the 'buyer added bid specific ATC document' attache d shall be adhered to. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
